body.objective: Audit the existing action-derived Berger emitter, detector, retarded-transfer and redshift certificates against the newly certified charged-time physical-receiver interface, deciding whether any legacy linear fixture supplies a genuine admissible receiver or exactly which first condition fails.
body.stop_condition: Import CHARGED_TIME_RECEIVER_ADMISSIBILITY_CROSSWALK_V1 and its interface by exact hashes. Discover, hash and classify the current Berger certificates for the dynamical rank-two emitter, localized rank-two transfer, exact detector smearings/advanced covectors, smeared retarded two-source/two-detector transfer, localized detector records, positive-energy selected preparations and quartic-calibration relational-redshift disposition. First prove or refute that they belong to one action-derived unary theory, background, charge fibre and residual quotient; stale or mutually incompatible rows must remain explicit failures. For every compatible candidate, fill all receiver fields: local BV class and cocycle, representative quotient, descended nonradical pairing, nonzero period, support-preserving retarded map, monotone clock band, positive denominator margin and separately typed D/R/K actions. Produce a complete fail-closed census with one first-missing-condition witness per rejected candidate, and promote a physical receiver only if every field is certified on the same carrier. Independently replay the rank, pairing-radical, support and denominator claims and mutate at least one cloned/radical receiver, one advanced-only map and one cross-background name match.
body.current_gate: legacy Berger action-derived receiver audit under the new admissibility contract
body.forbid: no certificate-name matching across backgrounds or unary theories; no advanced Green map interpreted as a signal; no positive classical coefficient called probability; no rank-two source map called a descended detector before the quotient and pairing checks; no resurrection of a fixed-charge relative clock; no nonlinear redshift, particle or quantum claim
activates: the first certified action-derived physical receiver if one survives
or an authoritative exact missing-condition ledger for the existing Berger detector programme
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER IMMEDIATE. This is an audit and synthesis theorem over existing exact fixtures, not a request to invent a receiver. Fail closed at the first carrier mismatch and preserve all negative dispositions.
